Manager – Customer Due Diligence ensures that requirements are delivered according to agreed priorities and in line with regulatory obligations, HSBC Group standards and internal policies. Also supports decision-making on Customer Due Diligence solutions and escalates issues, risks and dependencies when required. The role leads the implementation, governance, reporting and continuous improvement of Customer Due Diligence across Wealth and Personal Banking in the United Arab Emirates. Its purpose is to ensure that customer risks are properly understood and managed while HSBC meets its financial crime, regulatory and internal control obligations.
q: Financial-crime and Customer Due Diligence expertise Strong understanding of financial crime, Customer Due Diligence, AML/KYC activities, sanctions, counter-terrorist financing and proliferation-financing risks.
Banking and regulatory knowledge Knowledge of retail banking and financial services products, together with an understanding of the UAE regulatory environment and applicable Group requirements.
Leadership and change-management experience Experience creating or leading teams, managing reorganisations and implementing change in a financial-services or comparable environment.
Programme and project-management capability Proven ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands, plan effectively and deliver outcomes to deadlines.

Strong influencing and communication skills Ability to communicate and negotiate effectively at all organisational levels, build cross-functional relationships, explain risk-management requirements and influence stakeholders towards practical solutions.

3 year graduation degree is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up-to-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE.

r: Oversee the Customer Due Diligence/ Customer Tax Reporting programmes Manage delivery of Customer Due Diligence and Customer Tax Reporting activities across UAE Wealth and Personal Banking, aligned with agreed priorities.
Drive risk mitigation and control effectiveness Implement robust CDD controls, monitor financial-crime risks and ensure significant or emerging operational risks are escalated appropriately.
Manage quality assurance and remediation Oversee CDD quality control, quality assurance, audit and second-line reviews, ensuring identified issues and remediation actions are completed on time.

Provide governance, reporting and stakeholder updates Produce regular and ad-hoc reports, maintain accurate risk metrics and provide clear updates to senior management, risk committees and programme stakeholders.
Ensure regulatory and policy compliance Confirm that CDD processes comply with Group standards, local regulatory requirements, internal policies and audit or regulatory recommendations.

Lead collaboration and continuous improvement Work with Compliance, Operations, Relationship Managers, Change Delivery and other business teams to implement best practice, improve processes and support training and communication activities.

d: We are seeking a Red Hat Linux Administrator with strong hands-on experience in RHEL server administration, OS patching, hardening, environment configuration, and production support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, security, and reliability of Linux environments across development, testing, and production.
Administer and support Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers across enterprise environments.
Perform OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and system hardening .
Monitor server health, performance, capacity, and availability, and troubleshoot system-level issues.
Manage users, groups, permissions, services, filesystems, processes, and system configurations.
Support production environments and participate in incident, problem, and change management activities.
Implement security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and configuration standards.
Automate routine administrative tasks using Shell scripting and/or Ansible .
Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system configuration records.
4–6 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration, preferably in enterprise production environments.
Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration and troubleshooting.
Good understanding of Linux networking, filesystems, storage, DNS, SSH, systemd, processes, and permissions .
Experience with OS patching, server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management .
Hands-on experience with Shell scripting and/or Ansible .
Familiarity with monitoring, logging, backup, and enterprise infrastructure tools.
Experience working in 24x7 production support environments and following ITIL-based operational processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and incident-management skills.
RHCSA/RHCE certification or equivalent experience will be an advantage.
